representative_scale.selection: Entire fixed release-2024-02 PINDER-S subset with both primary apo structures; sorted IDs recorded before execution.
representative_scale.challenge_reason: Real listed entries fixed; assembly/domain selection not established. Do not substitute independent unbound structures.

inputs.monomers: Real primary paired-apo PINDER-S receptor and ligand PDBs; native holo dimer for scoring only.
inputs.scoring_input: FroDock bin/soap.bin with recorded digest; unverified study identity.
inputs.configuration: Fixed 5 output poses, MPI 8 from published default. Repeat seeds unavailable; record before stochastic runs.

outputs.metrics: eval_dir/frodock_metrics.csv with DockQ, iRMS, LRMS, Fnat per real pose
outputs.leaderboard: eval_dir/frodock_leaderboard.csv; rank-1 and Max(Top 5) hit rates reported separately
outputs.performance: Measured end-to-end wall clock, CPU/GPU use, candidate throughput and time to first acceptable pose where observable; cost requires actual provider billing rate, currently unavailable.

timing_scope.primary: Per-case receptor/ligand grid construction, docking search, clustering, coordinate generation and pose write; also full 93-case total.
timing_scope.separate: Setup/download/build and evaluator timing measured separately; warm/cold cache and MPI concurrency recorded.
timing_scope.first_acceptable: Evaluate candidate in observed generation order with timestamps; final ranked poses alone cannot establish discovery time.
timing_scope.budget: No extrapolation from toy workload; fixed complete 93-case workload. Runtime and memory remain unmeasured; do not claim budget compliance before calibration.

scoring_interface.acceptance: DockQ >= 0.23 for individual pose; no aggregate success tolerance or runtime target published here.
scoring_interface.missing_cases: Report failures and count missing poses as unsuccessful; do not shrink denominator.

budget_basis: Scheduling caps selected for fixed full subset, not published performance numbers. Setup/anchors/method_setup default 1200; tests 900. No runtime guarantee established; calibration must confirm adequate headroom before workloads.
execution_status: Intake only; no builds or scientific workloads executed. Published baseline source defects need repair before reproduction.
